$sources: MNBC 2020 seismic zone map of Myanmar (zones 1 to 5), for information
source: For information only: the upper peak ground acceleration [g] of each MNBC seismic zone (1 low, 2 moderate, 3 strong, 4 severe, 5 destructive) as SAEngine reads the zone map. The MNBC design spectrum takes the town's (or the project's) SS and S1 with Fa and Fv, not Z (seismic.designSpectrum.method mappedSpectral): a Z entered in Project Settings is not used.
